data.name: Ahnaf
data.gender_notes: Ahnaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'anaf, meaning 'gift, gifted, generous'. In Islamic tradition, it can also mean 'rare, precious, noble'. The name Ahnaf carries the meaning “Gifted, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahnaf usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
